notes.title: Big News: Necrologium launches September 30!
notes.notes:
[p]We’re thrilled to share some [b]major updates[/b] with you all:[/p][p][b]Ovid Works is officially the publisher of Necrologium![/b]
We’re incredibly happy to collaborate with our friends at Ovid Works, who will be supporting us in bringing the game to its full potential. Thanks to their help, we can finally announce the [b]official release date: September 30[/b].[/p][p][b]A brand new demo is available now![/b]
To celebrate this milestone, we’ve released a [b]new and improved demo[/b], featuring updated content and refinements based on your valuable feedback. It’s available right now on Steam, we can’t wait to hear what you think![/p][p][b]Thank you for your support[/b]
Your encouragement has meant the world to us throughout this journey. Please continue to support us by [b]adding Necrologium to your wishlist[/b], so you’ll be notified the moment the full game launches.[/p]

notes.title: We're Almost There – Thank You for Your Support!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone, 

We wanted to take a moment to share a quick update with you: yes, the game is coming, and it’s coming in September! We’re a small, passionate team, and after months of dedication and hard work, we’re excited to say that our game is on track to launch by the end of September.[/p][p]This journey hasn’t always been easy. As a small indie team, we’ve faced our fair share of challenges, but your support has made all the difference. Every wishlist, every message, and every word of encouragement has been a huge boost to us. Knowing that so many of you are waiting, curious, and excited, keeps us motivated every single day.[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who has added the game to their wishlist, who has reached out to ask how things are going, and who continues to support our project. It means more than we can express.[/p][p]If you have any questions or just want to say hi, feel free to contact us at [url="https://info@bobscult.com"]info@bobscult.com[/url] we’d love to hear from you.[/p][p]Stay tuned! More updates are coming soon. The mystery is almost ready to unfold.
[/p][p]With gratitude, 

Bob’s Cult Team[/p]

notes.title: Bug Fixed – The Daguerreotype is Back in Action!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

First of all, a huge thank you to everyone who has played the demo and shown interest in our project! Your support and feedback mean the world to us, and we’re incredibly grateful for the excitement around our game.

We've just released a small but important update for the demo. We noticed a bug that prevented the game from correctly creating and developing Serenity's daguerreotype, which was causing issues for some players.

What’s Fixed?

[list]
[*] The daguerreotype take now functions as intended.
[*] The reagent is correctly created and can be used properly.
[*] Minor fixes on the Serenity's autopsy and dossier.
[*] Minor fixes on in game SFX.
[*] Minor fixes on Main Menu save slots.
[*] Increased quality of the whole 3D analysis interactions.
[/list]

Your feedback helps us improve the game, and we truly appreciate it! Try out the updated demo and let us know if you encounter any other issues!

Bringing this project to life has been an incredible journey, and it’s an honor to share our little creation with you. We genuinely hope to meet your expectations and deliver an experience that you will enjoy and remember. Thank you for being part of this adventure with us!

[i]"…You have to discover the truth detective."[/i]

– Bob's Cult Studio
